landing_page.hero_section: Dark cinematic layout with radial ambient glow. Left column featuring bold Indian creator tagline ('Viral Shorts in Telugu, Hindi & Tamil in 60s'), language selector pills, primary CTA ('Launch Studio'). Right column featuring a sleek 9:16 mobile frame mockup with animated playing Short, Ken Burns effect simulation, live caption overlay, and engagement counter.
landing_page.style_showcase: 3-column grid highlighting the 6 aesthetic styles (Human AI, Cartoon, Cinematic, Emoji, Animals, Storybook) with hover zoom effects.
landing_page.workflow_stepper: Visual timeline breakdown showing the 6-step creation flow from Idea to AI Script Review to MP4 Render.
landing_page.pricing_section: 4-tier pricing grid (₹0 Free, ₹399 Creator, ₹999 Studio Pro, ₹2499 Empire) with popular tier highlighting and feature checkmarks.

studio_wizard.step_1_idea: Two prominent interactive choice cards: 'I have an idea' (with prompt input area & category chips) and 'Find me an idea' (with trending viral topics in Telugu/Hindi/Tamil). Features 'Entry' pill badge and icon accents.
studio_wizard.step_2_script: 3 AI reviewer agent panels (Trend Reviewer, Hook Specialist, Brand Safety Guard) providing real-time script feedback scores and suggestion bubbles.
studio_wizard.step_3_style: Heading 'Step 3 — Choose a video style' with a prominent 3-column grid of large rounded square image cards using /styles/{human,cartoon,cinematic,emoji,animals,storybook}.jpg with bold text labels beneath.
studio_wizard.step_4_scenes: Interactive 9:16 aspect ratio scene cards with image preview, keyframe text editor ('add rat near cat'), scene sequence sorter, and style prompt tuner.
studio_wizard.step_5_audio: AI voiceover selection with regional language audio samples (Telugu, Hindi, Tamil), voice record/upload tabs, and prominent 'Bharat Voice coming soon' feature banner.
studio_wizard.step_6_render: Live render progress stage with Ken Burns zoom preview toggle, automated caption styling selector, trending tag generator, and instant MP4 export button.

growth_coach.features: Audience Retention Chart (line chart with drop-off diagnostic points), AI Video Diagnosis card, and personalized 7-Day Weekly Action Plan for regional content dominance.

settings_page.features: AI Engine Roadmap showcasing integration statuses (Flux.1, Luma Dream Machine, ElevenLabs Regional, Bharat Voice Engine).

general_ui_ux_guidelines: Ensure dark mode contrast meets APCA standard with clear slate-100 text on #08090D and #10121B backgrounds.
Do NOT use pure #000000 background; use #08090D for depth and richness.
Do NOT leave interactive states plain; always add hover:border-cyan-500/50, transition effects, and focus rings.

All interactive elements (buttons, step cards, inputs, style selections, audio triggers) MUST include descriptive data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='choose-style-human', data-testid='step-idea-choice-own').
Include responsive layouts that look exceptional on both mobile and desktop screens.
